text: The UN human rights office found in 2022 that serious human rights violations had been committed against Uyghurs and other mostly Muslim communities in Xinjiang, including large-scale arbitrary detention that may amount to crimes against humanity. Human Rights Watch reported in August 2026 that hundreds of thousands of Uyghurs and other Turkic Muslims remain in prison.

source.name: UN OHCHR: OHCHR Assessment of human rights concerns in the Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region, People’s Republic of China
source.quote: Serious human rights violations have been committed in XUAR in the context of the Government’s application of counter-terrorism and counter-“extremism” strategies.

additionalSources.name: Human Rights Watch: China: Decade of Impunity for Crimes Against Uyghurs
additionalSources.quote: Since then, although some of these camps appear to have closed, hundreds of thousands of Uyghurs and other Turkic Muslims remain in prison
